title.zh: 将 Ozamiz 市 Montol 国立中学附属校从 Labo 国立中学分离并改设为名为 Montol 国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Montol National High School Annex From the Labo National High School in the City of Ozamiz and Converting It Into An Independent National High School To Be Known As the Montol National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Montol National High School Annex From the Labo National High School in the City of Ozamiz and Converting It Into An Independent National High School To Be Known As the Montol National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Montol Quốc gia khỏi Trường Trung học Labo Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Montol Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Montol แห่งชาติออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Labo แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Montol แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Montol Nasional dari Sekolah Menengah Labo Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Montol Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Montol Kebangsaan daripada Sekolah Menengah Labo Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Montol Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Montol National High School Annex is hereby separated from the Labo National High School in the city of Ozamiz, and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Montol National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports (DECS) shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Montol National High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Montol National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
